Profile Neue Materialien Bayreuth GmbH

Neue Materialien Bayreuth GmbH (NMB) is a non-academic research company, with the State of Bavaria being the principal shareholder. It focuses on developing novel materials and processing solutions for lightweight constructions based on polymers and metals. NMB provides application-oriented solutions by optimizing available materials and production processes.

Both, NMB offers a broad spectrum of services for material analysis and component testing with state of the art methods and laboratory technologies. In addition to R&D projects, NMB also contributes to prototypes and small series productions.
Products and services

The opening of NMB's SLS demo factory creates a platform for the further development of selective laser sintering (SLS) technology with a focus on automation, digitalization and sustainable material use. The facility offers solutions for process optimization and serves as a real laboratory for industrial application.
Together with its partner company Savuna, Neue Materialien Bayreuth (NMB) has investigated how recycled materials can be used to manufacture more sustainable and economical products.

As part of a joint project, Neue Materialien Bayreuth (NMB) is developing strategies for the production of unmixed particle foam hybrid components for use in the interior of innovative aviation transportation systems.
Successful completion of the Sumfoam research project: A steam-free process enables the production of lightweight molded parts from nanocellular particle foam beads for the first time.

Neue Materialien Bayreuth is establishing a fully networked and digitalized demonstration factory for the selective laser sintering of plastics as part of the Hightech Agenda Plus of the Free State of Bavaria. The entire process chain will be fully automated - from the powder to the tested component.
Large Area Additive Manufacturing (LAAM) is a polymer granulate-based additive manufacturing process on an industrial scale that is used to produce large-volume components (larger than 1 m³).

A transparent test mold made of acrylic glass gives NMB an insight into the filling process of particle foams. The filling of the mold determines the quality of the molded part. The insights into the mold are also the starting point for filling simulations.
In a collaborative project, Neue Materialien Bayreuth is researching how injection mold inserts with significantly improved cooling performance can be produced cost-effectively.

A new press with a maximum pressure of 6000 kilonewtons, equipped with various temperature control technologies, is intended to drive forward the development of polymer fiber composites, metallic and foamed materials in lightweight construction.

Finding a way to pre-foam particle foams without steam was the aim of a research project in Bayreuth. The result was a new, completely dry process using infrared radiation, for which a patent application has now been filed.

Neue Materialien Bayreuth GmbH is a non-university research center specializing in sustainable material solutions for plastics, metals, and hybrid systems. It develops innovative materials and energy-efficient processes, offering R&D, prototyping, and small series production for industrial applications.

Headmade Materials, AM Solutions and Neue Materialien Bayreuth jointly launch the "AutoSmooth" project to develop a continuous process chain for the CMF technology from powder to smoothed component - Headmade Materials
Headmade Materials, AM Solutions and Neue Materialien Bayreuth jointly launch the "AutoSmooth" project to develop a continuous process chain for the CMF technology from powder to smoothed component

The main objective of the AutoSmooth project is to create a fully automated process chain ideally matched to the properties of ColdMetalFusion components for unpacking and surface treatment within the next three years. Through the close cooperation of Headmade Materials, AM Solutions and Neue Materialien Bayreuth, the respective expertise will be bundled to master this essential challenge.

The expertise of AM Solutions, and thus Rösler's 80 years of experience, in the field of surface processing and the scientific excellence of Neue Materialien Bayreuth form the perfect foundation for the development of an automated process chain that meets the highest quality standards.

Dr. Till Merkel, Division Manager Technology at Rösler Oberflächentechnik GmbH, emphasizes, "Our many years of experience in surface processing combined with the high scalability of ColdMetalFusion and the research know-how of Neue Materialien Bayreuth will revolutionize additive metal series production."

The AutoSmooth project underlines the commitment of the companies involved to push the boundaries of what is possible and create groundbreaking solutions. The partnership will undoubtedly open the door to a new era of additive series production of metal components.

Neue Materialien Bayreuth GmbH is a renowned non-university research institution specializing in the research and development of novel materials and processes. All future-oriented processes of 3D printing are available at the Demo Center Additive Manufacturing in the Technical Center. The close connection to the University of Bayreuth ensures a strong scientific basis.
